items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: I certainly knew who Ricky Nelson was, you know

ctx.x: That’s a great story. Do you suppose the white kids were hearing most of that from the radio stations or were they actually buying the records?

They listened to the high end of the radio stations. I figured they listened to their end you know? I even figured they listened to that stuff, but they listened to that more than they listened — now I knew who Ferlin Husky was. I knew who the Big Bopper was. I certainly knew who Ricky Nelson was, you know, and I knew who Tammy Wynette was. You know I knew these people, some of them, and, but they knew all our people. They were big fans of Sam Cooke you know. And so I never did figure that I was playing for white…
Wonderful. The music that you were playing at that time at some point did you decide instead of going down this pop music road I have something I want to say in the jazz world?
